meta.title: Project Clone / Recreate: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify Project Clone/Recreate is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Buyer in the same tenant and verify Project Clone/Recreate is available.
Compare the clone outcome across the two role personas and determine whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to other roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify Project Clone/Recreate is refused or absent.; Sign in as a Buyer in the same tenant and verify Project Clone/Recreate is available.; Compare the clone outcome across the two role personas and determine whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to other roles.

steps.note: Open an existing project so the clone/recreate controls can be inspected in the relevant project context.

args.need: sign in as a non-Buyer and then as a Buyer on the same tenant, attempt Project Clone / Recreate for this existing project, and report whether it is absent, refused, or available for each role

steps.note: Role-specific sign-in and the required comparison are not expressible by the catalog.
Assert that the project screen remains usable after the tester's role comparison.
